name: How long does a multi-room painting project typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a multi-room painting project typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a multi-room painting project depends on several factors, including the number of rooms, their size, the type of paint and finishes chosen, and the amount of preparation required (e.g., patching, sanding). A project involving 2-3 standard-sized rooms might take 3-5 days. Larger projects, such as an entire floor or multiple rooms with complex architectural details, could extend to 1-2 weeks. City Dweller, LLC provides a detailed timeline during the estimation phase, considering all these variables to give you an accurate expectation for your property in the Bay Area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies by the number and size of rooms, paint type, and prep work. Expect 3-5 days for 2-3 rooms, or longer for larger projects.
